marketing_description: The Oliver Machinery Helical Cutterhead Planer (part 10014.201) delivers a 15‑inch cutting width and 6‑inch cutting thickness with selectable depth‑of‑cut options of 1/8‑inch or 3/16‑inch, driven by a 3 hp, 3450 RPM motor at 220 V, 15 A, 60 Hz, 1‑phase. It provides two speed settings and feed rates of 16 or 20 fpm, mounted on an iron housing with a 19‑5/8‑inch by 15‑inch table, and features digital control with a magnetic switch and a handwheel handle.
